newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Rainbow pulls into the black in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Rainbow pulls into the black in 1996.

text.p: Chemical fibre maker Hainan Sea Rainbow Group Co Ltd moved into profit in 1996 after a loss of 23.74 million yuan the year before, a company spokesman said on Thursday.

China's long-depressed textile market recovered in the second half of 1996 and high returns from securities investment were expected to boost the company's 1996 earnings, the spokesman told Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
He declined to provide an estimate for 1996 profit.
Rainbow's shares ended at 8.59 yuan on Thursday, down 0.15 yuan from Wednesday's close.

The official said he expected the firm's operations to improve further this year with help from a new major shareholder, Beijing-based Zhonghaiheng Industrial Development Co Ltd, a conglomerate founded by eight domestic enterprises.
Last month Zhonghaiheng bought 50 million of Rainbow's legal person shares, accounting for 24.83 percent of Rainbow's total share capital.
Zhonghaiheng would play a significant role in diversifying Rainbow into other sectors and extending its businesses to Beijing and Tianjin this year, the official said.
